hand.action: Let the silence speak. Your stillness is a statement.

hand.label: Temptation
hand.action: A pull toward something forbidden tugs at you. Act on it, or resist.

hand.label: Reversal
hand.action: You straighten, letting the room feel the shift in you.

hand.label: Confession
hand.dialogue: "There's something I've never said out loud..."
hand.action: A truth you've buried demands air. Speak it now, or swallow it again.

hand.label: Boundary
hand.action: Decide now what you will and won't permit—before the moment decides for you.
